title: Sonic the Hedgehog
description: Join Sonic as he races through six zones to stop the evil Dr. Eggman from enslaving the animal inhabitants of South Island.

title: Super Mario Galaxy
description: Join Mario as he travels across the galaxy, exploring colorful planets and collecting Power Stars to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser.

title: Kirby's Epic Yarn
description: Help Kirby explore a world made entirely of yarn, using his unique abilities to transform, defeat enemies, and collect treasures.

title: Pokémon Black and White
description: Explore the Unova region, catch and train Pokémon, and challenge Gym Leaders while uncovering the plans of Team Plasma.

title: Wii Sports Resort
description: Take part in a variety of sports and activities on the tropical Wuhu Island using the Wii Remote and Wii MotionPlus.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
description: Explore the vast kingdom of Hyrule as Link awakens from a long slumber and sets out to defeat Calamity Ganon.

title: Honkai: Star Rail
description: Board the Astral Express and travel across worlds while uncovering mysteries and battling enemies in turn-based combat.
